body.name: Moore--Penrose aggregate, localized, and published diagnostics
body.construction:
For each training complement of \(I_\ell\), form \(\widehat\Omega^{-\ell}\).  For the OVS comparator, solve each block KKT system
\[
\begin{pmatrix}\widehat\Omega^{-\ell}_{kk}&\mathbf 1\\ \mathbf 1'&0\end{pmatrix}
\binom{v_k}{\lambda_k}=\binom{0}{\omega_k}
\]
by its Moore--Penrose inverse; for the joint constant comparator, solve
\[
\begin{pmatrix}\widehat\Omega^{-\ell}&A\\ A'&0\end{pmatrix}
\binom{v}{\lambda}=\binom{0}{\omega}
\]
in the same way.  Take the minimum-Euclidean-norm loading component \(\widehat b^{-\ell,\mathrm{cmp}}\).  Report the three conditional residuals
\[
\widehat d^{-\ell}_{\mathrm{cmp}}(x)
=N'\widehat\Gamma^{-\ell}(x)\widehat b^{-\ell,\mathrm{cmp}},
\]
\[
\widehat e^{-\ell}_{\mathrm{cmp}}(x)
=\widehat E_{-\ell}\!\left[
\widehat Z^{\mathrm{per},-\ell}
\{\widehat b^{-\ell,\mathrm{cmp}\prime}\widehat\Psi^{-\ell}\}
\mid X=x\right],
\]
\[
\widehat f^{-\ell}_{\mathrm{cmp}}(x)
=\widehat E_{-\ell}\!\left[
\widehat Z^{\mathrm{OVS},-\ell}
\{\widehat b^{-\ell,\mathrm{cmp}\prime}\widehat\Psi^{-\ell}\}
\mid X=x\right].
\]
They diagnose, respectively, equality with the aggregate pairwise-score optimum, the localized-model bound, and the published OVS bound.  Stack them as
\(\widehat D^{-\ell}_{\mathrm{cmp}}=(\widehat d^{-\ell}_{\mathrm{cmp}},\widehat e^{-\ell}_{\mathrm{cmp}},\widehat f^{-\ell}_{\mathrm{cmp}})\).
